question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To foot the bill
solution:
The correct answer is **"****To make payment."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom 'to foot the bill' is** **to pay for something, esp. something expensive. (कुछ के लिए भुगतान करने के लिए, खासकर कुछ महंगा) 

 
 
• ​Example:* His parents can't afford **to foot the bill**__ for his college education.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is "To make payment."
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.
